title: Mixing: Big Barn Bed, When The Night by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Two songs for Wings’ second album, Red Rose Speedway, were mixed on 9 January 1973: ‘Big Barn Bed’ and ‘When The Night’.

Studio engineer Alan Parsons made five stereo mixes, numbered RS1-RS5, of ‘Big Barn Bed’, and three of ‘When The Night’. The last of each was selected by Paul McCartney for the album.

Page last updated: 26 November 2025
